method: Human-model visual review of eight native IAB screenshots of SHA-bound final WebPs at 390x844 and 1024x768; repeat 2x2, shifted phase, seams at 1:1, single tiles.

assets.name: factory-floor-a
assets.note: Joint-centre crop removes the separated double boundary lines in both axes. Four slab periods cover 8x8 world units (average 2x2 per slab). Opposite edge pixels are not identical; grout width/brightness and grain differ slightly. Thin horizontal interior joints become faint at reduced scale, especially the shifted-phase 390 view; native 1:1 joints remain visible.

assets.name: factory-floor-b
assets.note: Joint-centre crop removes the separated double boundary lines in both axes. Four slab periods cover 8x8 world units (average 2x2 per slab). Opposite edge pixels are not identical; grout width/brightness and grain differ slightly. Wear is slightly stronger and colour slightly lighter than A; overall grid scale agrees.
